body: I noticed the frequency was off by just one kilohertz from a known interference pattern I'd been tracking for weeks. My pulse quickened as an idea formed—maybe someone had altered or added signals in my area intentionally. Without hesitation, I reached for my phone, dialing a trusted local authority number to report it immediately. Before anyone could speak, I cut through their response with urgency, demanding immediate investigation and intervention to ensure this malicious activity stops.
